notes.title: New levels and MORE!
notes.content:
Hey gamers!

Viktor from fungames here. 
   - We are back from holiday, thats why there wasnt any updates in some time, no one is dead (and no one is dying as of now from our team) We will now often add alot of updates.

We just made a BIG update.

[i][u][b]We added following:[/b][/u][/i]

5 NEW Levels!

NEW And enhanced audio quality

More Retro Looking Style

More scratch looking style

Multiplayer Level (Do you have a friend, who owns a copy of Shopping Simulator? If you do, there will be a new button saying "PLAY WITH A FRIEND" And when you press that, you will get 20 Unique teamwork levels for you and your friends to play!)


NB: The multiplayer level button, is only visible if you have a steam friend that also own Shopping Simulator and you both have plaid the game for 3 Hours or more. The 3 hours dosn't need to be active gameplay but steam gameplay, therefor in main menu and AFK'ing is also counting.


To celebrate this some of our DLC, will go on sale in 5 hours from when this was posted!

- Sincerely,
Viktor,
Fungames CEO,
Stay safe!
